claims.text: Rifaximin (to reduce the risk of overt hepatic encephalopathy recurrence in adults):
claims.quote: XIFAXAN is indicated for reduction in risk of overt hepatic encephalopathy (HE) recurrence in adults.

claims.text: 550 mg orally two times a day.
claims.quote: The recommended dosage of XIFAXAN is 550 mg taken orally two times a day.

claims.text: P-gp inhibitors (eg, cyclosporine) can substantially raise systemic rifaximin exposure: use caution.
claims.quote: Concomitant administration of drugs that are P-glycoprotein (P-gp) inhibitors with XIFAXAN can substantially increase the systemic exposure to rifaximin. Caution should be exercised when concomitant use of XIFAXAN and a P-gp inhibitor such as cyclosporine is needed.
